Read-only. Source -> commit latency, real values from `ingest_ts` (migration 081), no simulated data. Does **not** show time-until-next-dashboard-refresh -- that's a per-dashboard config choice (5s-5m), not a pipeline latency. See `tests/e2e/ingestion-latency-check.js` for the same measurement as a scriptable evidence artifact.

panels.title: ◉ ldi_data

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.description: P95 source_ts -> ingest_ts latency, LDI manufacturing telemetry, last 15 minutes.

panels.title: ◉ ldi_alarm_log (causal)

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - logdate)) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_alarm_log WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND link_basis = 'causal'

panels.description: P95 source_ts -> ingest_ts latency, condition-driven alarms only (logdate = real telemetry-query-resolve time, not backdated). This is the real alarm ingest latency. Alarms are rare/debounced by design -- low sample count in a quiet window is expected, not a bug.

panels.title: ◉ ldi_alarm_log (nearest)

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - logdate)) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_alarm_log WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND link_basis = 'nearest'

panels.description: NOT real pipeline latency -- background noise-code alarms get logdate intentionally backdated by the simulator (almsim_gen, up to 9000ms) to fake a realistic detection delay. This panel measures that simulated delay, not ingestion speed. See 'causal' panel for real latency. No color thresholds (blue = informational only, not a pass/fail signal).

panels.title: ◉ sys_metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.description: P95 source_ts -> ingest_ts latency, SNMP host telemetry, last 15 minutes.

panels.title: ◉ net_metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.net_metrics WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.description: P95 source_ts -> ingest_ts latency, SNMP network telemetry, last 15 minutes.

panels.title: ◉ ldi_metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_metrics WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.description: P95 source_ts -> ingest_ts latency, SNMP LDI-telemetry channel, last 15 minutes.

panels.title: ◈ ldi_data: source → commit latency over time

targets.rawSql: /* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: ldi_data_1m CAGG has no ingest_ts column (checked live, information_schema.columns) -- this panel's whole purpose is measuring ingest_ts, so raw ldi_data is unavoidable, not a tiering-contract oversight */ SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', "time") AS time, 'P50' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: see P50 target, ldi_data_1m has no ingest_ts */ SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', "time") AS time, 'P95' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: see P50 target, ldi_data_1m has no ingest_ts */ SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', "time") AS time, 'P99' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Real per-minute P50/P95/P99 of (ingest_ts - time) for ldi_data -- the highest-volume production table. NO_TIMEFILTER caveat does not apply here: this panel needs the dashboard time range.

panels.title: ◈ INFRA TELEMETRY LATENCY TREND (P95, all 3 SNMP tables)
◈ sys/net/ldi_metrics: P95 source → commit latency over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', "time") AS time, 'sys_metrics' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', "time") AS time, 'net_metrics' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.net_metrics WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', "time") AS time, 'ldi_metrics' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingest_ts - "time")) * 1000) AS value FROM public.ldi_metrics WHERE ingest_ts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Real per-minute P95 of (ingest_ts - time) for the 3 SNMP infra-telemetry tables.
